results.title: Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat
results.overview: When Vikramaditya, a powerful politician falls  for a strong-willed superstar Adaa , their passionate romance quickly spirals into a dangerous game of obsession and pride. As emotions clash and tempers rise, Adaa makes a life-altering choice.

results.title: Francis
results.overview: Based loosely on the life of Saint Francis of Assisi, Francis follows a young woman's grief-driven spiral into opioid abuse and piety.

results.title: Omnivore
results.overview: A small rundown hotel turns out to be not such a simple place as it seems. People come here who are willing to pay any price to have their wishes fulfilled. Guests await luxurious rooms tailored to every taste, exquisite dinners, and... a personal maze of illusions. Each floor becomes a mirror of one soul, exposing fears, greed, and secrets that people have hidden even from themselves for years. To leave the hotel, they must pass through their own true reflection – but not everyone will have enough courage and willpower to do so.

results.title: ¿Quién mató a la cucaracha?
results.overview: An unprecedented event takes place in Okania, a planet parallel to Earth where the gender structures and behaviors of the Idiots are meticulously studied. The death of the cockroach marks the beginning of a dark chapter in their own civilization, which ends with an even more unsettling occurrence.

results.title: Adisyon
results.overview: At the end of the meal, two bourgeois fathers quarrel over the bill.

results.title: Trigger
results.overview: Thailand, 2030 — In an era where the government has legalized euthanasia through the organization ITB (In The Blink), Doc, a middle-aged “Negotiator,” is tasked with screening and evaluating those who request to end their lives for valid and justified reasons. But when a radical youth movement demands the legal age for euthanasia to be lowered — sparking debates over whether life’s achievements should come early, or even matter at all — tensions erupt and spiral into a crisis Doc and the organization could never have foreseen.

results.title: Fog of War
results.overview: With WWII raging around them, an injured pilot and his fiancée find themselves stranded on a remote estate. As the Allies plan the D-Day Invasion, the couple become aware of a Nazi spy hiding amongst them with stolen documents bound for Germany. Unsure of who to trust, and facing danger around every corner, they must uncover the spy’s identity as the outcome of the war hangs in the balance.

results.title: Le temps des femmes ?
results.overview: Has the time of women finally come? Have their everyday lives truly changed over the past sixty years? Guided by Agnès Jaoui, women—famous and unknown—share their stories across generations. From childhood to retirement, the documentary traces shared experiences shaped by prejudice, but also by hope, strength, and humor. Blending personal archives, historic moments, and social media footage, the film places women at the center of their own story. Welcome to the Time of Women.

results.title: Primal Games
results.overview: A newlywed couple embarks on the honeymoon of a lifetime, only to discover they are the unwitting victims of a cruel and sadistic vacation experience.

results.title: Gowok: Javanese Kamasutra
results.overview: Set in 1960s Java, a young Javanese woman betrays her teacher, falls in love and must face dire consequences.

results.title: The Life of Wishes
results.overview: Felix is at an impasse in his family life and his job. His wife Bianca wants a separation, his children are moving away from him and his hair is falling out. When he also loses his job, Felix finds himself on the edge of the abyss. That's when a mysterious stranger offers him three wishes.

results.title: El húsar de la muerte: Historia de un hallazgo
results.original_title: El húsar de la muerte: Historia de un hallazgo
results.overview: In 1958, filmmaker Sergio Bravo bought a sack of old film reels on the street—material destined to be turned into hair combs. The sack contained seven 35mm nitrate reels of the film "El húsar de la muerte" (1925), directed by Pedro Sienna. Leading researchers and guardians of the country's film heritage recount, from various perspectives, the story of a discovery that changed the course of Chilean cinema.

results.title: Universe Designed
results.overview: "Universe Designed" is a documentary that explores some of the evidences for God's existence with interviews from some of the world's top Christian apologists.

results.title: The Blade Cuts Deeper
results.overview: Many people want their five minutes of fame but for some, it comes at the ultimate price - their life!' Meet John Abbott, narcissistic host of infamous real-crime show Lights, Camera, KILL. Known for its lurid re-enactments of the darkest of trespasses, it has made him rich by exploiting pain and suffering. Yet while Abbott basks shamelessly in the limelight, one victim has seen enough. Broken by his loss, the man has a burning thirst for revenge - and now he wants to make Abbott bleed.

results.title: russia goodbye
results.overview: The film tells the story of a Ukrainian woman who has lived in occupation for 10 years, where not only has her brain been completely washed, but she has also become a preacher of sick ideas and fakes about Ukraine herself. According to the plot, due to unforeseen circumstances, the heroine ends up in Western Ukraine, where reality turns her world upside down.
